description: Explain what an EVM transaction would actually do: decodes the calldata (ERC-20 transfers/approvals via known ABIs, unknown selectors via the 4byte directory) and simulates the call against live chain state to report the outcome — including unlimited-approval warnings — without sending anything. Use this when an agent needs to decode and simulate a transaction — before signing it. x402 price $0.005/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
